name: Watched Playlist Cleaner
description: Automatically sorts your playlists by watched status. Unwatched items appear first sorted by release date, watched items move to the bottom. Triggers automatically when items are marked as watched or unplayed.
overview: Automatically sorts your playlists by watched status. Unwatched items appear first sorted by release date, watched items move to the bottom.

versions.changelog: Fix sort order for streaming episodes with identical release dates — uses season and episode number as tiebreakers. Add combined install/update setup script.
